name: nulnul-harness
description: Find proven capabilities, assemble the smallest useful agent system, complete the work, and improve it from measured results.

interface.longDescription: Describe the outcome. nulnul harness inspects the project, finds and verifies existing skills before creating new ones, assembles only the agents the workflow needs, completes the work, and keeps improvements that pass real checks.
defaultPrompt: Build this project. Find proven skills before creating new ones, and keep the setup minimal.
Turn this recurring workflow into a verified automation and improve it from real runs.
Review this project's results and simplify or upgrade its skills and agents only where evidence supports it.
